selection.split: SHA256(round-carry-split-v1|USER) first8bytes bigendian mod2;0 discovery,1 confirmation
selection.on_limit: stop before model forwards; no silent truncation or hash retuning

probe_boundary: Second invocation of work block input only. Save original first prediction state y1. For slot j set q2[j]=entry[j] (zero carry), or entry[j]+donor_increment[j]. Original increment=(z1-entry)/2 semantically; native unperturbed q2 uses original (entry+z1)/2 arithmetic. Replay native must be exact before interpreting intervention.
extra_distinct_probe: swap learned round gate rows; both work and prediction states may change; report separately from q2-only interventions

donor_rule.within: same discovery/confirmation split and prespecified history-length bin
donor_rule.construction: distinct user groups sorted by deterministic donor hash; for each source user choose next cyclic user; choose its row by source-row deterministic hash modulo donor row count
donor_rule.exclude: same-user donors; bin with<2users has no shuffle estimate
donor_rule.conditional_scope: preserves coarse history-length stratum, not full conditional distribution; shuffle harm is reliance, not proof of beneficial retraining

slot_selection: Within each checkpoint choose two largest discovery macro(mean4task)BCE harms from single-slot zero, tie by slot index. Precommit this pair before confirmation pair forward. Report all four single slots even if negative. Same4slots no cross-checkpoint semantic alignment.

estimands.row_gain: BCE_perturbed-BCE_native; positive indicates native route beneficial on that observed label
estimands.primary_heterogeneity: For zero_all, six pairwise history-bin differences of mean gain per task, on confirmation users
estimands.slots: six pairwise single-slot zero gain differences per task per checkpoint; selected pair joint minus sum of its two single-slot effects
estimands.trained_effect_heterogeneity: On same confirmation groups, BCE gain distinct_carry vs shared_carry and mature_r2, using their saved native predictions; compare directly between bins
estimands.positive_fraction: descriptive fraction of observed rows with g>0, zero ties separately; not fraction with identified positive individual causal effect

inference.stream: same resampled user multiplicities across every checkpoint/intervention/metric on confirmation subset
inference.bce: sum row gains weighted by user multiplicity divided by corresponding weighted row count in each subgroup
inference.empty_draw: mark metric insufficient if any required denominator zero, do not resample until convenient
inference.auc: existing weighted AUC core, user multiplicities mapped to rows; no per-row AUC
inference.family: exploratory95percent intervals, all predeclared effects retained without selection/multiplicity correction; pair-selection independent confirmation only
inference.only_some_claim: Not established from a nonsignificant group. Report detected heterogeneity and uncertainty; no exhaustive task/sample exclusivity claim.

budget.explanation: At most2native passes+10fixed interventions+1selectedpair percheckpoint plus1distinctswap=40*256=10240 forwards; remaining760 only reserved explicit parity checks, never adaptive subgroup fishing.

coverage.toolkit_analyze_perturbations: Provides descriptive paired deltas; block bootstrap over step is not arbitrary repeated-user cluster sampling. Do not use its block CI as confirmation user CI. Run descriptive route with bootstrap_iterations0 if used.
coverage.existing_user_core: Reuse paired-analysis user multiplicities and weighted mean/AUC equations; add repository-local group masks and contrast algebra, validate against expanded user-row oracle before real inference.
coverage.new_tool_decision: No new estimator proposed yet; if reuse fails to cover group/slot contrasts, invoke diagnostic-tool-evolver before introducing one.
